atoms.text: Arthur is an English tour guide. Will you explore England with him?

instruction.text: Arthur asks if you know where England is. Select the UK map with England highlighted.

feedback.correct: This is England! England is the biggest country in the UK and is connected by land to both Scotland and Wales.

instruction.text: The tour will start and end in England’s capital city. Answer Arthur’s question.

atoms.a: “What is the name of England’s capital city?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m6'>What is the name of England’s capital city?</voice>

instruction.text: Answer Arthur’s question using the map.

hint.text: Look at the compass in the top left corner. The letter N means north, and the letter S means south.

atoms.a: “Are we starting our tour from the north or south of England?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m6'>Are we starting our tour from the north or south of England?</voice>

instruction.text: Arthur wants to know if you recognise the sights of England. Select the three images of places in England.

feedback.wrong: This is Hawaii. England doesn’t have tropical islands and volcanoes.

instruction.text: Arthur wants to show you around both the cities and landscapes of England. Drag the images to the correct group.

feedback.finish: England has a population of over 55 million people. Most of these people live in towns and cities.
